# grepr_splunk_integration (Resource)

Manages a Splunk integration. Set either `splunk_host`, or `ingest_host` and `web_host` for separate endpoints. Tokens are always validated against the configured Splunk endpoints when saved. Secrets are written through dedicated endpoints after the integration is saved. They are sensitive but stored in Terraform state. They are write-only: the API never returns them, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. Removing a secret from the configuration stops managing it without deleting it remotely. If a secret is rejected while the integration is being created, Terraform marks the integration tainted; run `terraform untaint` and apply again to retry the secret without replacing the integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "splunk_hec_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "grepr_splunk_integration" "main" {
  name        = "production_splunk"
  splunk_host = "splunk.example.com"
  auth_token  = var.splunk_hec_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name.

### Optional

- `auth_token` (String, Sensitive) HTTP Event Collector token, validated against the ingestion endpoint.
- `ingest_host` (String) Host for HTTP Event Collector ingestion. Set together with `web_host`.
- `ingest_port` (String) Ingestion port. The server defaults it to `8088`. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current value.
- `rest_auth_token` (String, Sensitive) REST API token, validated against the REST endpoint.
- `rest_host` (String) Host for the REST API.
- `rest_port` (String) REST API port. The server defaults it to `8089`. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current value.
- `secure` (Boolean) Verify the Splunk endpoints' TLS certificates. Requests always use HTTPS; `false` accepts self-signed certificates. The server defaults it to `true`. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current value.
- `splunk_host` (String) Host serving ingestion, REST and web traffic. Use instead of the separate hosts.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) Team IDs with access. Omit to keep the current teams; an empty set clears them.
- `web_host` (String) Host for the Splunk web UI, used to link to backfilled logs. Set together with `ingest_host`.
- `web_port` (String) Web UI port. The server defaults it to `443`. Removing it from the configuration keeps the current value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization owning the integration.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Integration version used for optimistic locking.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import grepr_splunk_integration.main INTEGRATION_ID
```
